name: Omega Core Everywhere
author: Oddisz
description: Omega cores drop from destroyed Omega ships, no Astral Ascension needed, and do something in every colony building that takes an AI core: production buildings make twice as much for half the demand at double the upkeep, and the rest get effects of their own, shown in the core picker and each building's tooltip. Covers the base game, Industrial Evolution, AoTD Vaults of Knowledge and Terraforming & Station Construction; none of them is required. Drop chance and an off switch for the effects are in the LunaLib settings.
